title: Fractional Triangle Decompositions at Partite Minimum Degree $4n/5$
summary: We prove that every triangle-divisible balanced tripartite graph whose vertex classes have size $n$ and whose partite minimum degree is at least $4n/5$ admits a fractional triangle decomposition. Combined with the multipartite decomposition theorem of Barber, Kühn, Lo, Osthus, and Taylor, this implies that, for every fixed $\varepsilon<1/5$ and all sufficiently large $n$, every $\varepsilon$-dense partial Latin square of order $n$ is completable, improving the previous asymptotic bound of $2/25$.
